title: xDrip Does not send local broadcast
symptom: After the latest update, the app stopped sending local broadcasts. The logs show no mention of broadcast sent even though the local broadcast setting is enabled. The issue also occurs intermittently for another user, and a third user reports that xDrip+ appears to send broadcast data but custom apps cannot receive it.
evidence_quote: After the latest update for some reason, the app stopped sending local broadcasts.
